items.text: 很折磨啊，刚开始的几个小时储存空间给的很少，一个拖车基本上船里没空间了，补给站里背包也少刷。开局打工任务又有很多要跑很远的前期根本没法做的任务，要么就是反复的刷k站内的一趟一两千的快递任务。拆船拆出来的部件一般占地巨大，塞不进储物箱船上也没地放，正常的思维当然是直接卖掉吧，结果这些垃圾可以在k站里随地乱放不会消失，留着修船塞到房间里才赚的多点。这时候跑去外面想拆船拆点墙和地板出来扩建船和修船骸居然不能直接下多个命令，要我一个一个点。战斗根据天赋来要么疲劳攻击到高二氧化碳要么三拳打死镇关西。对话交流选项那么多，聊几轮下来感觉也压根没什么变化。路上想上npc的船随便上，压根不会跑，把npc船上东西全拆了也没半点反应。看着全是细节，实际上是百疏一密。

items.text:
Unfortunately, I cannot in good conscience recommend this game. I like the concept of it - starting with a small ship in mortgage, access to a ship boneyard for a nominal fee (or for free if you're good at hiding from cops) and some skills in building ships and tearing them apart. Simulated electrical systems, pressure, malfunctions such as fires or navigation station software bugging out. Build out your ship, travel the Solar System, do some stuff - questing, trading, asteriod mining, even participating in a war, good stuff, good ideas.

The problem is bad implementation. The deeper you go into the game, the more problems you find with various systems. The gases don't go through adiabatic cooling, which is reasonable for a game, so any gases you pump into your ship are at room temperature, but *sometimes* re-pressurising a room ends up with it being barely a few Kelvin hot. Characters that are prone to choosing the way around the ship if they can, doesn't matter if that way happens to go outside and they have no EVA suit on (space, remember?). Autotasking, which is basically required if you don't want to click your character through installing 400 floors and 80 walls one by one, is very bad in a lot of ways that are too long to go into details here. Barely anything happens during time skip, so if you want any work done, you'll have to let your characters do the work and go watch Youtube or something. Characters still can't replace batteries in tools without dropping flat batteries on the ground instead of properly inserting them into chargers. And speaking of tools, they will choose the first tool they find when you need one, not "the best in their inventory" or anything like that, so you need to take care to not leave old tools in any reachable places. CO2 filters never get used up, so while CO2 buildup is still bad for your character, that particular system is half-baked. Item sorting in kiosks for buying/selling is arcane.

Flight is Newtonian... to a point, it doesn't simulate gravity faithfully enough (in my opinion) and the navigation station doesn't give you enough tools to utilize the fact. Fuel isn't accounted in ship mass, which you could argue is a gameplay decision, but cargo in cargo pods does count in ship mass, so I dunno. Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes.

I could go on and on, but you get the idea. I have two problems with this game. I played this game for 250 hours total, about 150 hours back when I just bought it and about 100 hours near and after release. This game pulled me in enough that I tried to figure out and work around all this problems, be it by modding, adapting my processes to the s*** factor, or any other ways. But at some point my will just broke. This game is an exercise in frustration, and in the end frustration subsumes any amount of enjoyment I got out of this game. The game is full of bugs, Discord bug forum is full of bugs, and only a small amount of them gets acknowledged and even smaller about fixed. The devs say "report the bugs", but even after you report it *and provide source code for a mod that fixes it*, chances are the bug will stay in the game for weeks ahead. I don't have patience to wait for months, but some well-known problems have stayed for years, apparently, so make what you will of it. That's the first and the biggest problem. The second, as the dev's community manager eloquently put it in Discord, "this game's elevator pitch is Firefly episode generator". There is a reason I'm indifferent to Firefly as opposed to Star Trek, and it's the setting. This game won't tell you power draw or any other specs for spaceship equipment. It won't tell you how much thrust thrusters produce or how far sensors can detect things. You're supposed to wing it. I don't like it.

By the way, I like Rimworld. Rimworld is also a "story generator". It's also a lot, lot, lot better implementation-wise than this game. Don't get fooled by comparison.

So there it is. Apparently this game has a deep simulation for characters relations, mental needs etcetc, but it was too arcane for me to figure it out, so I just ignored it. As is the norm for the game, it won't tell you anything, you're supposed to figure things out. Maybe this is not a one-guy-or-small-team-flying-spaceship simulation game but a dating simulator in space with elements of shipbuilding? I dunno. If you want to get the game, make absolutely sure your expectations match what it is.
items.text_zh:
遗憾的是，我无法凭良心推荐这款游戏。我喜欢它的概念——从一艘还在按揭的小船开始，可以花点小钱（或者如果你擅长躲警察就免费）进入飞船坟场，还有一些建造和拆解飞船的技能。模拟电气系统、压力、火灾或导航站软件故障等故障。建造你的飞船，在太阳系中旅行，做些事情——任务、贸易、小行星采矿，甚至参与战争，好东西，好想法。

问题在于糟糕的实现。你在游戏中越深入，就会发现各种系统的问题越多。气体不会经历绝热冷却，这对游戏来说还算合理，所以你泵入飞船的任何气体都是室温的，但*有时候*给房间重新加压后，它却只有几开尔文的温度。角色倾向于选择绕飞船的路，如果可能的话，不管那条路是否会通到外面，而他们又没穿EVA服（太空，记得吗？）。自动任务分配，如果你不想一个个点击角色安装400块地板和80面墙，基本上就是必需的，但它在很多方面都非常糟糕，细节太长这里就不展开了。时间跳过期间几乎什么都不会发生，所以如果你想完成任何工作，你就得让角色干活，自己去看YouTube什么的。角色仍然无法更换工具里的电池，而是把没电的电池扔在地上，而不是正确地插入充电器。说到工具，当你需要一个工具时，他们会选择找到的第一个工具，而不是“他们库存中最好的”之类的，所以你得小心，不要把旧工具留在任何可触及的地方。CO2过滤器永远不会用完，所以虽然CO2积累对你的角色仍然有害，但那个特定系统是半生不熟的。售货亭里买卖物品的分类方式神秘莫测。

飞行是牛顿式的……到一定程度，它（在我看来）没有足够忠实地模拟重力，导航站也没有给你足够的工具来利用这一事实。燃料不计入飞船质量，你可以说这是游戏性决定，但货舱里的货物确实计入飞船质量，所以我不知道。行星际旅行的自动驾驶作弊，使用过多燃料，有时还会把你撞进行星。

我可以继续说下去，但你明白意思了。我对这款游戏有两个问题。我总共玩了250小时，大约150小时是我刚买的时候，大约100小时是在发布前后。这款游戏足够吸引我，以至于我试图弄清楚并绕过所有这些问题，无论是通过模组、调整我的流程来适应这坨屎，还是其他方式。但到了某个时候，我的意志就崩溃了。这款游戏是一场挫折的练习，最终挫折感吞没了我从中获得的任何乐趣。游戏充满bug，Discord的bug论坛充满bug，只有一小部分被承认，被修复的就更少了。开发者说“报告bug”，但即使你报告了*并且提供了修复它的模组源代码*，这个bug很可能还会在游戏中停留数周。我没有耐心等几个月，但一些众所周知的问题显然已经存在多年了，所以你自己看着办吧。这是第一个也是最大的问题。第二个，正如开发者的社区经理在Discord上雄辩地说的，“这款
游戏的电梯游说是“萤火虫剧集生成器”。我对《萤火虫》不像对《星际迷航》那样感兴趣是有原因的，那就是它的设定。这款游戏不会告诉你飞船设备的功耗或任何其他规格。它不会告诉你推进器产生多少推力，或者传感器能探测到多远的东西。你应该自己随机应变。我不喜欢这样。

顺便说一句，我喜欢《环世界》。《环世界》也是一个“故事生成器”。在实现方面，它也比这款游戏好得多得多得多。别被这种比较骗了。

所以就是这样。显然，这款游戏对角色关系、心理需求等有深度模拟，但对我来说太晦涩难懂了，所以我干脆忽略了它。就像这款游戏的常态一样，它什么都不会告诉你，你应该自己去弄明白。也许这不是一个单人或小团队驾驶飞船的模拟游戏，而是一个带有造船元素的太空约会模拟器？我不知道。如果你想买这款游戏，一定要绝对确保你的期望与它的实际内容相符。

Fun for a bit but the more you play the more it's clear this isn't close to finished. this was quite clearly kicked out of early access by factors external to game development.  aka the publisher, financial reasons or the dev maybe being sick of it??

i'd call it maybe 50% done.

i spent far too much time at the starting station and now that i've gone out and explored the system it's like an empty mall

there's basically 3 functional locations and a dozen more that are empty apart from a few basic NPC's and standard services. 
CQB combat and social gameplay are virtually identical and feel completely unimplemented. they're basically press button to be friendly / not so friendly. for example flirting consists of making a single weird facial expression over and over and over and over again. and you experience that in a scrolling text field.

Crew management is like the sims with terrible AI. it's just obnoxious. when i restarted a fresh save i just didn't bother getting any more crew than the player character.

What is fun and implemented well:

- Ship navigation (RCS or torch drive) it really feels like you're steering a brick through space or a brick tied to a nuclear reactor that's throwing fusion exhaust out of the bottom.
- Ship to ship combat.  caveat: it's basically isolated to 1 location unless you go full murderhobo

What's okay

- Constructing your ship.  it works but oh dear lord is it tedious to design and modify your brick
- Mining.   it's functional and somewhat tied in with ship combat (it's a contested zone).  but not particularly amazing. it's fine.

what's bad:

- Crew control.  Half the time the autotask stops working for some inexplicable reason and you have to take care of every persons needs the sims style.  literally half of the needs are convoluted and annoying to deal with (the social needs) where 1 is almost impossible to satisfy (altruism) 
- 80% of the solarsystem is bland empty stations with nothing special to do.
- Social / CBQ combat.  it's spamming the same things over and over to achieve the desired result with little in the way of useful feedback.
- The performance is atrocious.  loading takes ages, saving takes ages, the autotask function stutters the game constantly if you make your character build something as simple as a 10x10 floor
- There's 0 quality of life.    that 10x10 floor?   you'd better have manually filled some backpacks with flooring cause otherwise your character will grab them 1 by 1 by 1.  i'm just glad there's a mod that helps with picking up 100 pieces of floor first. cause the alternative is that you basically do that manually!
items.text_zh:
玩一会儿挺有趣，但你玩得越多就越清楚这离完成还差得远。这很明显是被游戏开发之外的因素踢出了抢先体验。也就是发行商、财务原因，或者开发者可能自己都玩腻了？？

我会说它大概完成了50%。

我在起始空间站花了太多时间，而现在我出去探索了这个星系，它就像一座空荡荡的商场

基本上只有3个有功能的地点，还有十几个除了几个基础NPC和标准服务之外空空如也的地方。
室内近战和社交玩法几乎一模一样，感觉完全没有实装。它们基本上就是按按钮来表示友好/不那么友好。比如调情就是一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍地做一个奇怪的面部表情。而你是在一个滚动文本框里体验这些的。

船员管理就像AI糟糕透顶的《模拟人生》。就是很烦人。当我重开一个新存档时，我干脆懒得招募任何超出玩家角色之外的船员。

好玩且实现得不错的部分：

- 飞船导航（RCS或火炬驱动）真的感觉像是在太空中驾驶一块砖头，或者一块绑在核反应堆上、从底部喷出聚变尾焰的砖头。
- 舰对舰战斗。但有个前提：除非你彻底化身杀人狂，否则它基本上只局限于1个地点

还行的部分

- 建造你的飞船。它能用，但天哪，设计和修改你这块砖头真是太繁琐了
- 采矿。它能用，而且某种程度上和舰船战斗挂钩（那是个争夺区）。但并不是特别惊艳。还行吧。

糟糕的部分：

- 船员控制。有一半时间自动任务会因为某些莫名其妙的原因停止工作，你就得像《模拟人生》那样照顾每个人的需求。字面上一半的需求都复杂又烦人（社交需求），其中1个几乎不可能满足（利他主义）
- 太阳系的80%都是平淡空洞的空间站，没什么特别可做的。
- 社交/室内近战。就是一遍又一遍地重复同样的事情来达到想要的结果，几乎没有什么有用的反馈。
- 性能糟糕透顶。加载要花很久，保存要花很久，如果你让你的角色建造一个简单到只有10x10的地板，自动任务功能就会让游戏不断卡顿
- 生活质量改进为0。那个10x10的地板？你最好已经手动往几个背包里装好了地板材料，否则你的角色会一块一块一块地拿。我真庆幸有个mod能帮忙先捡起100块地板。因为替代方案基本上就是你得手动去做！

items.text:
I've been following and playing Ostranauts through years of EA and I'm pleased that is now officially released.

I'm a game developer myself and I often like to play games to see new ideas and new mechanics - this game is full of really interesting ideas.

The progression from - how am I ever going to progress to slowly building up your knowledge of the game, your equipment, your ship, making a good find and the realistic feel of the world is very worthwhile.

It has a lot of things to like:
- interesting character creation scenarios
- awesome derelicts to explore
- meaningful scrapping
- fun encounters
- interesting social dynamics
- feels impactful when you talk yourself out of situations like bribing the authorities
- a nicely thought out world

I have not come close to finishing the game - just a few scrapping runs, travelling between a few stations and some in-game socializing.
Though I wanted to give the game a thumbs up.

Some things that would make it better:
- more choice over the initial ship
- visual spaceflight for ship travel - I would prefer full joystick-like movement - though it would at least be better if there was a viewport showing your progress than just essentially a 2D vector plot
- the inventory management on the characters and the ship
- the uninstalling, installing and fixing can drag on - though it deepens your immersion into the world

Note that I just play as a single NPC and I haven't been hiring crew / adding AIs.

It has a bit of jankiness that rankle me as a developer - though I feel I am more than getting my money's worth.
items.text_zh:
我在抢先体验的这些年里一直关注并游玩《Ostranauts》，我很高兴它现在正式发布了。

我自己也是一名游戏开发者，我经常喜欢玩游戏来了解新想法和新机制——这款游戏充满了非常有趣的创意。

从——我到底要怎么才能进步——到慢慢积累你对游戏、你的装备、你的飞船的了解，做成一笔好买卖，以及这个世界逼真的感觉，这种进程非常值得。

它有很多值得喜欢的地方：
- 有趣的角色创建场景
- 超棒的废弃飞船可供探索
- 有意义的拆解
- 有趣的遭遇
- 有趣的社会动态
- 当你靠嘴皮子摆脱困境，比如贿赂当局时，感觉很有成就感
- 一个经过精心构思的世界

我离通关还差得远——只跑了几次打捞，在几个空间站之间旅行，以及一些游戏内的社交。
不过我还是想给这款游戏点个赞。

一些能让它变得更好的地方：
- 对初始飞船有更多选择
- 飞船旅行的可视化太空飞行——我更希望有完整的摇杆式移动——不过至少如果有一个显示你进度的视口，而不是基本上只是一个2D矢量图，那也会更好
- 角色和飞船上的物品栏管理
- 卸载、安装和修理可能会拖得很长——不过这也加深了你对世界的沉浸感

注意，我只扮演一个NPC，我还没有雇佣船员/添加AI。

它有一些作为开发者让我恼火的粗糙之处——不过我觉得我得到的远远值回票价。

items.text: Not a big fan of y'all banning someone for "misinformation" because he has the apparent wrong opinion on the games current state. I haven't even experienced most of the reported issues yet but there's so many quality of life thins that should just be plain obvious to fix years ago (thank god for modders so I can simply haul what I uninstall without having to micro). Not to mention talking to NPCs seemed buggy, but I figured it was a one off issue, now that I read it's a common occurrence and apparently recommended to just not deal with them? How is this 1.0 worthy. It certainly actually feels like a game unlike the early days, but it seems to need more than the one year of support it's allegedly even going to get.
items.text_zh: 不太喜欢你们因为某人“散布虚假信息”就封禁他，只因为他对游戏当前状态显然持有错误的观点。我甚至还没经历过大多数被报告的问题，但有太多生活质量方面的事情，几年前就应该显而易见地修好（感谢模组作者，这样我就可以直接搬运我卸载的东西，而不用手动微操）。更不用说和NPC对话似乎有bug，但我以为那是一次性的问题，现在读到我发现这是常见现象，而且显然建议干脆别和他们打交道？这怎么配得上1.0。它确实感觉像一款游戏，不像早期那样，但它似乎需要的支持不止据称它将获得的那一年。

items.text:
The most lovable piece of ♥♥♥♥ rust bucket of a game. 

For a game about building ships and inventory management it really does suck at doing both of those. QOL is literally not present. If i need to collect scrap in any meaningful way I have to store it in a cargo pant, in a backpack, in a crate... None of which you can shift click.

Having said all that, this game is awesome. Literally nothing else like it. Hope the devs really pull through on this.
items.text_zh:
最可爱的一坨♥♥♥♥锈桶游戏。

对于一个关于造船和库存管理的游戏来说，它在这两方面都真的很烂。生活质量功能简直不存在。如果我需要以任何有意义的方式收集废料，我得把它放进工装裤里，再放进背包里，再放进箱子里……这些都不能用 shift 点击来移动。

话虽如此，这游戏还是很棒。真的没有别的东西像它一样。希望开发者们真的能挺过去。

items.text:
If you're looking at this page, Ostranauts absolutely delivers on the experience you're looking for. The worldbuilding really puts you into the setting, and the core gameplay mechanics have you feeling like a proper spacer. Unfortunately, this is all marred by the absolutely atrocious state the game is in.

At its core, this is a game about inventory management. Both the size and shape of your ship is going to determine what types and what amounts of salvage you can bring aboard. External cargo netting is cheap, light, and quick to lay down, but accessing its inventory means donning a suit for a spacewalk. Underfloor storage bays are expensive, but they allow you to fit a large amount of salvage in a smaller, more convenient space that can even be pressurized. Unfortunately, they're also heavier, which means they have a more sizeable impact on your fuel and thrusters.

For all this, the actual tools the game has for inventory management are absolute garbage. It's 2026, and the game doesn't even have a "Deposit/Stack similar items" button for containers. Shift-clicking prefers to deposit items on the ground instead of the active container, which means you'll have to manually drag items into their proper containers, one by one. This is a game with 10 different types of scrap; all of which are needed for repairing various salvage. There is a host of various supplies you need to keep track of on your ship, and the game does nothing to help make it easier.

And then there's the bugs. So much of the UI seems to be either placeholder or so broken it doesn't even work. The "resume order" button which appears on every pending order has simply never worked for me; to force a character to manually do an assigned work order, you'll have to cancel the order, then start it up again from their specific menu. There is an entire menu for a task priority system, but it's all placeholder, as it doesn't actually do anything.

A good hazard should be either preventable or react-able. Having it be neither is what leads to frustrating gameplay. Fires are seemingly not preventable. A breathing environment that is 100% oxygen is highly combustible, so adding nitrogen to the mix will help reduce the chances of fires starting. Damaged electronics have a chance of malfunctioning and starting a fire, so keeping everything maintained is important. Unfortunately, doing any welding work has a chance of setting surrounding items on fire, regardless of environment or condition. Doing welding work on a wall can set fire to the perfectly maintained power line embedded in it. Doing welding work on a reactor core with nothing flammable in the room has a chance of your character setting their own pants on fire.

Fires are also not truly react-able. If you immediately respond to a fire by having everyone don their pressure/eva suits (which they keep in their inventories at all times for such emergencies), then begin using their fire extinguishers (which they also keep in their inventories at all times for such emergencies), while having someone immediately vent the ship to starve the fire & and pull out the smoke... everyone who was in the room now has chronic emphysema from smoke inhalation. The fact that fires are a hazard that are neither fully preventable nor react-able without permanent consequence is the reason why you can see every other recent negative review complaining about fires. This is on top of the fact that, like everything else in the game, fires give no feedback at all on what actually caused the fire, so new players will have an especially rough time figuring out what's going on.

Building ships is the epitome of the poor UI design in this game. The game has one menu for installing tiles & components, and a separate menu for every other order in the game. You can not pull both of these menus up at the same time. This means that if you need to undo a build order, you'll need to back out of the build menu and go into the orders menu to cancel it. 

There is also no option for selecting a palette or filtering out any of the build options. The game only has the bare minimum of separate categories (HVAC, Powergen, Hull Tiles, etc). This means that when you go back to the build menu, you've lost your place and have to find the tiles you were working with. These all seem like small nitpicks, but they're things that add up and build frustration with time. 

Speaking of small nitpicks, there is so much pointless micromanagement, and the game is prone to the kind of mistakes you only make because you're playing a video game. For some odd reason, left & right shoes are treated as separate entities instead of being bundled together. This adds nothing to the game. It's just 4 extra pointless clicks that can be another pain point if you, going through the motions, somehow manage to put the shoe on the wrong foot. If so, your character can develop painful blisters that slow down work/movement speed. Your character won't complain, so this can persist until you tab to them, wonder why they're in pain, then realize they have their shoes on the wrong feet. It feels like the video game equivalent of a pointless DM gotcha. This doesn't happen in real life. People don't usually just put their shoes on the wrong foot by accident and then deal with it until they get blisters on their feet.

Clothing management is an interesting system, but it's such a slog to actually go through. Casual clothes are comfortable and reduce filth gain. This is important, since crewmembers on break need to be comfortable to read skill books and generate increased filth if they're working out. Unfortunately, there's no uniform system, so, even on scheduled break time, characters won't switch back to their casual clothes by themselves. This leads to more pointless micro you have to do for every character you control.

God forbid a crewmember decide it's a good time to go for a 6-hour marathon after you forget to doff their eva suit (which increases filth gain). Characters are coded to automatically use hygiene packs when they get dirty, but if you run out (which you will, because the station doesn't stock enough), there is no option to allow them to automatically use the copious amounts of water you have for washing. There is no cap on filth, and no ability to queue tasks, so you can waste minutes just watching and retasking a character to wash themselves off with water instead of hygiene packs. The AI in general is a crapshoot, and constantly wastes your time with its problems.

The kicker is that a lot of these problems have persisted even after a "hardening phase" in which the developers focused on QoL and bugfixing.

This game desperately needs a QoL pass by someone with some proper UI/UX experience. There are also a lot of broken elements that simply aren't the sort of things you leave until the end to fix. Underneath all the dirt, there is an absolute gem of a game here. However, unless you're patient, have a lot of free time on your hands, and absolutely in love with the genre, I highly recommend waiting for the game to be in a more polished state.

I eagerly await the day I can change this review, but, until then, I've already been lead astray by other Early Access titles that have focused on constant content updates while leaving maintenance work by the wayside. More often than not, tech debt accumulates to the point where the developers decide to just release as-is; sometimes even starting work on a sequel with a "stronger base". I pray that Ostranauts can buck the trend, because there's a really good game underneath all the mess.

如果你正在看这个页面，那么 Ostranauts 绝对能提供你正在寻找的那种体验。世界观构建真正让你沉浸到设定之中，核心玩法机制让你感觉自己就是个正经的太空人。不幸的是，这一切都被游戏目前极其糟糕的状态给毁了。

从本质上讲，这是一款关于库存管理的游戏。你飞船的大小和形状将决定你能带上船的打捞物类型和数量。外部货网便宜、轻便、铺设迅速，但要访问它的库存就意味着得穿上宇航服进行太空行走。地板下的储物舱很昂贵，但它们能让你在更小、更方便甚至还能加压的空间里装下大量打捞物。不幸的是，它们也更重，这意味着它们对你的燃料和推进器有更显著的影响。

尽管如此，游戏实际用于库存管理的工具简直是垃圾。都2026年了，游戏甚至没有一个针对容器的“存入/堆叠同类物品”按钮。Shift点击更倾向于把物品放到地上而不是当前激活的容器里，这意味着你不得不手动把物品一个一个拖进它们该去的容器。这是一款有10种不同废料的游戏；而修复各种打捞物都需要用到它们。你船上有一大堆各种补给需要跟踪管理，而游戏完全不帮忙让它变得更容易。

然后就是bug。UI的很大一部分似乎要么是占位符，要么坏得根本不能用。每个待处理订单上出现的“恢复订单”按钮对我来说从来就没起过作用；要强迫一个角色手动执行分配的工作订单，你得先取消订单，然后从他们的专属菜单里重新启动它。有一个完整的任务优先级系统菜单，但全是占位符，因为它实际上什么都不做。

一个好的危险应该要么可预防，要么可应对。两者皆非正是导致令人沮丧的游戏体验的原因。火灾似乎无法预防。100%氧气的呼吸环境高度易燃，所以在混合气体中加入氮气有助于降低起火几率。受损的电子设备有几率发生故障并引发火灾，所以保持一切维护良好很重要。不幸的是，进行任何焊接工作都有几率点燃周围的物品，无论环境或状况如何。在一面墙上进行焊接工作可能会点燃嵌入其中维护得完美无缺的电线。在一个没有任何易燃物的房间里对反应堆核心进行焊接工作，有几率让你的角色把自己的裤子点着。

火灾也不是真正可应对的。如果你对火灾的立即反应是让所有人穿上他们的压力服/EVA服（他们为了这种紧急情况一直把这些放在自己的库存里），然后开始使用他们的灭火器（他们同样为了这种紧急情况一直把这些放在自己的库存里），同时让某人立即给飞船泄压以饿死火焰并排出烟雾……原本在那个房间里的每个人现在都因为吸入烟雾而患上了慢性肺气肿。火灾是一种既不能完全预防、也不能在无永久性后果的情况下应对的危险，这就是为什么你能看到其他每一条最近的负面评测都在抱怨火灾。除此之外，就像游戏里的其他一切一样，火灾完全不提供任何关于究竟是什么引发了火灾的反馈，所以新玩家会尤其艰难地搞不清楚到底发生了什么。

建造飞船是这款游戏糟糕UI设计的典型代表。游戏有一个用于安装地板砖和组件的菜单，而游戏里其他所有订单则有一个单独的菜单。你无法同时调出这两个菜单。这意味着如果你需要撤销一个建造订单，你得退出建造菜单，再进入订单菜单去取消它。

也没有选择调色板或过滤任何建造选项的功能。游戏只有最低限度的几个独立分类（暖通空调、发电、船体地板砖等）。这意味着当你回到建造菜单时，你已经丢失了原来的位置，不得不重新找到你之前正在处理的地板砖。这些看起来都像是小的吹毛求疵，但它们是会随着时间累积并滋生挫败感的东西。

说到小的吹毛求疵，游戏里有太多毫无意义的微观管理，而且游戏很容易犯那种你只因为是在玩电子游戏才会犯的错误。出于某种奇怪的原因，左脚鞋和右脚鞋被当作独立的实体，而不是捆绑在一起。这对游戏毫无增益。这只是多出4次毫无意义的点击，而且如果你在机械地操作时不知怎么把鞋穿错了脚，这还可能成为另一个痛点。如果穿错了，你的角色会起疼痛的水泡，从而减慢工作/移动速度。你的角色不会抱怨，所以这种情况可能会一直持续，直到你切到他们身上，纳闷他们为什么在疼痛，然后才意识到他们把鞋穿错了脚。这感觉就像是电子游戏版的毫无意义的DM陷阱。这在现实生活中不会发生。人们通常不会不小心把鞋穿错脚，然后一直忍着直到脚上起水泡。

服装管理是一个有趣的系统，但实际走一遍流程实在太累人了。休闲服舒适并能减少污垢积累。这很重要，因为休息中的船员需要舒适才能阅读技能书，而如果他们正在锻炼则会积累更多污垢。不幸的是，没有制服系统，所以即使是在预定的休息时间，角色也不会自己换回休闲服。这导致你不得不为你控制的每个角色做更多毫无意义的微观操作。

天哪，要是你忘了让某个船员脱下他们的EVA服（这会增加污垢积累），而他们决定这时候去跑个6小时马拉松，那可就糟了。角色的编码设定是当他们变脏时会自动使用卫生包，但如果你用完了（你一定会用完的，因为空间站储备不够），就没有选项允许他们自动使用你手头大量用于清洗的水。污垢没有上限，也没有排队任务的能力，所以你可能会浪费好几分钟就只是看着一个角色并重新指派他们用水而不是卫生包来清洗自己。AI总体来说就是一场赌博，不断用它的各种问题浪费你的时间。

最要命的是，很多这些问题即使在开发者专注于QoL和修bug的“加固阶段”之后依然存在。

这款游戏迫切需要由某个有正经UI/UX经验的人来做一次QoL优化。还有很多损坏的元素，根本不是那种你可以留到最后再修的东西。在所有这些污垢之下，这里有一款绝对堪称瑰宝的游戏。然而，除非你有耐心、手头有大把空闲时间、并且绝对热爱这个类型，否则我强烈建议等游戏进入更完善的状态再说。

我热切期待有一天我能修改这篇评测，但在那之前，我已经被其他那些专注于不断更新内容却把维护工作抛在一边的抢先体验游戏带偏过了。很多时候，技术债会累积到开发者决定就这么原样发布的地步；有时甚至带着“更坚实的基础”开始做续作。我祈祷 Ostranauts 能逆势而行，因为在这一团乱麻之下，真的有一款非常好的游戏。

Media embodiment of autism. Clocked close to 50 hours within the first few days of playing this. Yet I've decided to put it down until it becomes more polished.

There is just this feeling with this game that the developers are so driven to create a complex system that they aren't focused to slow down and refine the individual core processes that are the pieces that bring that system alive.

They're soon to add ship-combat but how long can they keep putting systems together before it eventually just becomes too much? I would really suggest the developers to slow down a little and simply work out how to make the game more playable (the keyword being playable, not fun, nor complex - both it is - but playable).

A few core systems are lacking depth that pull you out of the game given how immersive it can be at times:
- mental status/social/relationships seem to have no real significant impact on gameplay; I rolled a smoker character. To light a cigarette you have to a) have cigarettes in the pack itself) b) action the pack of cigarettes to light a cigarette) c) put out the cigarette but dragging it from your mouth to the trash or on the floor - turns out if you're suffering a nicotine withdrawl it does little to actually affect your gameplay meaning you can simply select smoker for a free point and never smoke. 
- The UI is incredibly clunky and difficult to navigate; Why can't I pin my inventory to always be displayed? The game becomes a slog after you start to manage your needs alongside your crew and ship. Why can't I customise the UI features? I don't half my screen obscured by an event log when half the event log is fluff in itself. 
- variety of items (excluding ship items)

I don't know if this is a bug or not but I left items outside of the ship during a derelict run and when I docked at the station all the items were still where I left them but had somehow traveled half way across the star system without being in a cargoweb? I spent 15 minutes putting together a cargo web system on the backend to ensure I can carry more items to find out I can just game it by not doing so (which I refuse to do so but it just pulls you out when you know you can. It also turns out you can just use floor tiles to do so as well... Why bother with a cargo web item if you can just a) game the system, b) rip a floor off a ship your salvaging and always have storage - this gets to a point where you start to not worry about what you can take and can't take as you know you can just rip stuff apart and throw it on the back of your ship without any care or worry...

Further example... Docked my ship but forgot to turn off my proximity alarm. Time to now close down my menu, walk all the way back to my ship, right click the NAV centre - slot them in. Click the alarm. Make them get out of the seat. Walk all the way back. The feature of the proximity alarm is crucial to space travel - why can't there be a little toggle next to it in-it-self to toggle on and off upon docking? You can link your NAV console to your PDA - why can't I simply toggle it from my PDA? Or simply add a new PDA chip that allows you to do so? These little touches that would make it less of a chore.

I think this will hands down be the best simulator on the market once the time comes - but it's a matter of when, not if. 

I still highly recommend it - the above is simply feedback for the developers.

自闭症在媒体中的化身。在开始玩这款游戏的几天内，游戏时间就接近50小时。然而我决定先放下它，直到它变得更加完善。

这款游戏给人一种感觉：开发者如此执着于创建一个复杂的系统，以至于他们没有专注于放慢脚步，去打磨那些让整个系统活起来的各个核心流程。

他们很快就要加入飞船战斗，但在最终变得太多之前，他们还能把系统拼凑多久？我真的建议开发者放慢一点，简单地想办法让游戏更可玩（关键词是可玩，不是有趣，也不是复杂——这两者它都具备——而是可玩）。

有几个核心系统缺乏深度，考虑到游戏有时能如此沉浸，这会把你从游戏中拉出来：
- 精神状态/社交/关系似乎对玩法没有真正显著的影响；我随机了一个吸烟者角色。要点燃一支烟，你必须 a) 烟盒里本身有烟 b) 对烟盒执行动作来点燃一支烟 c) 熄灭香烟，但要把烟从嘴里拖到垃圾桶或地板上——结果发现，如果你正遭受尼古丁戒断，它实际上对玩法几乎没有影响，这意味着你可以直接选择吸烟者来白拿一个点数，然后永远不抽烟。
- UI极其笨重且难以操作；为什么我不能把物品栏固定为始终显示？当你开始同时管理自己的需求、船员和飞船时，游戏就变成了一件苦差事。为什么我不能自定义UI功能？我可不想半个屏幕被事件日志挡住，而事件日志本身有一半都是废话。
- 物品种类（不包括飞船物品）

我不知道这是不是bug，但我在一次废弃飞船探索中把物品留在了飞船外面，当我在空间站停靠时，所有物品都还在我留下的地方，却不知怎么在不在货网里的情况下穿越了半个星系？我花了15分钟在后端搭建了一个货网系统，以确保我能携带更多物品，结果发现我只要不这么做就能钻空子（我拒绝这么做，但当你知道自己可以这么做时，它就会把你从游戏中拉出来。结果还发现你只要用地板砖也能做到……如果你能 a) 钻系统空子，b) 从你正在打捞的飞船上拆下一块地板，然后永远都有存储空间，那还要货网物品干什么——这到了某个地步，你开始不再担心自己能拿什么、不能拿什么，因为你知道你可以随便把东西拆开，毫不在意、毫不担心地扔到飞船后面……

再举个例子……我把飞船停靠好了，但忘了关掉我的接近警报。现在得关掉我的菜单，一路走回我的飞船，右键点击导航中心——把它们放进去。点击警报。让它们从座位上起来。再一路走回去。接近警报这个功能对太空旅行至关重要——为什么不能在它旁边本身就有个小开关，在停靠时切换开和关？你可以把你的导航控制台连接到你的PDA——为什么我不能直接从我的PDA上切换它？或者干脆加一个新的PDA芯片让你能做到这一点？这些小小的细节会让它少很多麻烦。

我认为等到时机成熟，这毫无疑问会是市场上最好的模拟器——但问题是什么时候，而不是会不会。

我仍然强烈推荐它——以上只是给开发者的反馈。

items.text:
I bought this game a couple years ago but decided to wait for further development after half an hour. Recently a friend tried it and so I decided to give it another chance.
I have put 40 hours into it this week.

This game has a lot of issues. Inventory micromangement is terrible, a lot of tasks that seem like they should be handled automatically by autotask aren't (swapping batteries is the most notable), there isn't much content in some areas such as equipment with most functional ship parts having only one example per class, it often stutters for unclear reasons, as far as I am aware you get no information on the price of a new employee until after you hire them, there is no automation of transferring gasses between canisters, the list goes on.
I recommend this game because it is heavily systems driven with things like atmospheric pressure and gravity/acceleration being very well modeled while the core loop of going and ripping things apart to sell to stay alive is to me extremely satisfying. The steady progression of struggling debt slave to small business owner is one I wish more games had.

items.text:
A flawed gem that kept pulling me back - but after 4 years, hope is gone. 

Ostranauts is a complex, deeply atmospheric game. I love the sci-fi setting — it feels alive and grounded. The systems are intricate, interwoven, and demand full attention. The tension and immersion it creates are unmatched.

I also really like the panels and cockpit elements — flipping switches, managing ship systems, and navigating the old-school interfaces is incredibly satisfying.

But... it’s also ugly as hell. The UI is clunky and unintuitive. Cargo management becomes a punishing Tetris-like chore — boxes in boxes, micromanaging every tile. I enjoy micromanagement, but this inventory system and its ugly UI is just too cumbersome. This is a waste of the players time which bothers me too much. 

And don’t get me wrong — I love that you have to take care of everything: different batteries, ship-supplies, food, water, meds, sleep, even toilet, go ahead make it as complex as possible — but please just not that cumbersome.

It’s a pity such a great setting had to be so ugly and frustrating from a look & feel perspective. 

Ostranauts offers something rare: a raw, immersive experience where failure teaches, and every small victory feels earned.

I’ve spent a lot of time researching “Ostranauts-like” games — and while you’ll find suggestions, none truly offer what this game does. I genuinely believe that with a graphical and interface overhaul, Ostranauts could be something big
items.text_zh:
一颗有瑕疵的宝石，让我不断回来——但4年后，希望已逝。

Ostranauts是一款复杂、氛围深厚的游戏。我喜欢这个科幻设定——它感觉鲜活而扎实。系统错综复杂、相互交织，需要全神贯注。它营造的紧张感和沉浸感无与伦比。

我也非常喜欢那些面板和驾驶舱元素——拨动开关、管理飞船系统、操作老派界面，令人极其满足。

但是……它也丑得要命。UI笨拙且不直观。货物管理变成了一种惩罚性的类俄罗斯方块苦差事——箱子里套箱子，每个格子都要微操。我喜欢微操，但这个库存系统及其丑陋的UI实在太累赘了。这是在浪费玩家的时间，让我太在意了。

别误会——我喜欢你必须照顾一切：不同的电池、飞船补给、食物、水、药品、睡眠，甚至上厕所，尽管让它尽可能复杂——但请别那么累赘。

很遗憾，这么好的设定，从观感和手感的角度却不得不如此丑陋和令人沮丧。

Ostranauts提供了某种罕见的东西：一种原始、沉浸式的体验，失败能教会你东西，每一个小胜利都感觉是挣来的。

我花了很多时间研究“类Ostranauts”游戏——虽然你会找到一些推荐，但没有一个真正提供这款游戏所提供的东西。我真心相信，只要对画面和界面进行彻底改造，Ostranauts可以成为一款大作

The concept of the game is great, but the constant stuttering undermines the overall experience. The game freezes briefly whenever I click, give orders, or move the camera. At 16x speed, it starts to stutter every two seconds. Most of the time I spent watching the crew haul or disassemble things, and adding more people to the crew to make things faster, only makes the stutters and micromanagement even more annoying.

Storage is also a mess. Every bin, crate, and locker is ridiculously small. I had to edit the game files just to make it bearable. Inventory management is tedious too, shift-clicking only moves items to the ground or into random inventory, so you end up manually dragging everything (or shift-clicking everything to the ground and then picking it up with a different storage in hand, so just more micromanaging). 

There's a great game here, but right now it's buried under performance issues and frustrating systems.

Also, in my opinion, they should hire a proper UI designer to point them out how [strike]shi[/strike] tedious their system is.

Worth keeping an eye on, coming back for a short game every couple of months, but still it's not enough to fully enjoy it.

存储也是一团糟。每个箱子、板条箱和储物柜都小得离谱。我不得不编辑游戏文件才让它勉强能忍受。物品管理也很繁琐，Shift点击只会把物品移到地上或随机物品栏里，所以你最终得手动拖拽所有东西（或者Shift点击所有东西到地上，然后手里拿着另一个储物箱再捡起来，所以只是更多的微操管理）。

这里有一款很棒的游戏，但现在它被性能问题和令人沮丧的系统埋没了。

另外，在我看来，他们应该雇一个正经的UI设计师来指出他们的系统有多[strike]屎[/strike]繁琐。

值得关注，每隔几个月回来玩个短局，但仍然不足以完全享受它。

Removed a wall while remodeling ship, forgot there was no floor underneath. Died for the first time in 40 hours of IRL playtime. Then suddenly don't feel like playing anymore. 

Would play again 10/10

.... but maybe in a year or so.

Game has an enjoyable gameplay loop. I'm all in for rags to riches type of game and this game delivers on that end, at least in the early game. It also nails it on the atmospheric end.
Which makes you want to actually be a little corporate drone.

However, the game is still full of bugs and jankiness. For example...
- the inventory UI overflows with containers if you're standing still and opening multiple containers, even if you don't have access to them. Containers should close once character doesn't have access to them, instead they get crossed out adding to the problem. So quite often you have to work around this jankiness by "refreshing" the UI via closing/reopening the inventory window.
- context menu hotkeys are always changing and some are dangerous, like jettison or bash. So you end up being extra careful or just clicking the option, which kind of defeats the purpose of hotkeys.
- context menu remains open after choosing an option, so you always need to move it out of the way or manually close it. Super awkward for a context menu.
- the longer you play the game, the worse the performance gets. I have a gaming PC that runs 4K 3D games without missing a heartbeat. Meanwhile this game manages to lag frequently.
- little weird bugs like something breaking all of the sudden that I just repaired to full health. 

... I could go on, but basically there are some questionable UI decisions that add jank to the game. Then the game is littered with bugs that you have to work around. And to top it off, the game is in bad need of some optimization. All in all, game is probably worth half of what it is in its current state. So, unless you want to pay to be QA, I'd say wait a while longer until the game is more stable.

Cool concept nonetheless.

在改装飞船时拆掉了一面墙，忘了下面没有地板。在40小时现实游戏时间中第一次死亡。然后突然就不想再玩了。

会再玩 10/10

……但也许得等一年左右。

游戏有一个令人愉快的玩法循环。我完全支持白手起家类型的游戏，而这款游戏在这方面做到了，至少在游戏早期是这样。它在氛围方面也做得很到位。
这会让你真的想当一个小小的公司 drone。

然而，游戏仍然充满了 bug 和粗糙感。例如……
- 如果你站着不动并打开多个容器，即使你无权访问它们，物品栏 UI 也会被容器塞满。当角色不再有权访问容器时，它们应该关闭，但它们反而被划掉，加剧了问题。所以很多时候，你不得不通过关闭/重新打开物品栏窗口来“刷新”UI，以绕过这种粗糙感。
- 上下文菜单热键总是在变，而且有些很危险，比如抛弃或猛击。所以你最终会格外小心，或者干脆点击选项，这多少违背了热键的意义。
- 选择选项后上下文菜单仍然开着，所以你总是需要把它移开或手动关闭。对于一个上下文菜单来说，这超级别扭。
- 你玩得越久，性能就越差。我有一台能毫无压力运行 4K 3D 游戏的游戏 PC。与此同时，这款游戏却经常卡顿。
- 一些奇怪的小 bug，比如我刚修到满血的东西突然坏了。

……我还能继续说，但基本上，有一些可疑的 UI 决策给游戏增加了粗糙感。然后游戏里到处都是你不得不绕过的 bug。最要命的是，游戏急需一些优化。总而言之，以目前的状态，这游戏大概只值它售价的一半。所以，除非你想花钱当 QA，否则我建议再等一段时间，直到游戏更稳定。

不过概念还是很酷。

items.text:
Can't recommend after the developer made it clear they don't care about the abundant bugs. They've essentially put out a barely playable beta version that manages to dazzle with a seemingly promising outlook and a great soundtrack. And to be clear, this could be a great game if they ever got beyond the basics.

This outlook got corrected with the dev stating that after six years of part-time development, they don't have any plans to go beyond 1% of the initially promised content of a living solar system. This happened right after they managed to get an infamous "indie-riffic" publisher (meaning "never the big time") with more bug-ridden shovelware games on board. The devs are not above deleting critical threads on the forum, and reporting and banning players for imagined infractions either.

It's not just the game breaking bugs that have been discussed many times on the forum without response from the devs. I had to use the debug console multiple times just to keep my save going, not to cheat in any way. It's also a line of baffling design decisions about the clunky UI producing endless amounts of inventory tetris and other annoyances. NPC AI is broken beyond belief even in the "1.0" version. Even save game management is broken in ways that should never have been released to the public.

The basic gameplay loop features almost zero actual tactical decisions, instead it's 95% waiting for timers to run down. Timers to uninstall parts, timers to repair them. Then return to the space station to sell everything and watch the game break in front of your eyes. Hoarding and selling like the most basic 90s dungeon crawler but surprise: there is no actual dungeon. Even the fights are a poor excuse for what could have been. Most quests simply break along the way and cannot be completed.

Another failed early access title, and the part-time amateur developers who put two types of marihuana cigarettes into their game don't even understand how to work constructively with the community for modding and content creation.
items.text_zh:
在开发者明确表示他们不在乎大量bug之后，无法推荐。他们基本上发布了一个勉强能玩的测试版，靠着看似有前途的前景和出色的配乐让人眼花缭乱。而且要说清楚，如果他们能超越基础层面，这本来可能是一款很棒的游戏。

这种前景在开发者声明之后被纠正了：经过六年的兼职开发，他们没有任何计划去实现最初承诺的活太阳系的1%内容。这发生在他刚刚找到一个臭名昭著的“独立范儿”发行商（意思是“永远成不了大气候”）之后，该发行商旗下还有更多满是bug的劣质游戏。开发者也不是不会删除论坛上的批评帖子，还会因为想象出来的违规行为举报和封禁玩家。

不只是那些在论坛上被讨论过很多次却得不到开发者回应的破坏游戏的bug。我不得不多次使用调试控制台只是为了让我存档能继续下去，完全不是为了作弊。还有一系列关于笨拙UI的令人费解的设计决策，产生了无穷无尽的库存俄罗斯方块和其他烦人之处。NPC AI即使在“1.0”版本中也破碎得令人难以置信。甚至存档管理也以绝不应该公开发布的方式坏掉了。

基本玩法循环几乎没有任何实际的战术决策，相反，95%的时间都是在等待计时器走完。卸载零件的计时器，修理零件的计时器。然后回到空间站卖掉一切，看着游戏在你眼前崩溃。像最基础的90年代地牢爬行游戏那样囤积和出售，但惊喜来了：根本没有真正的地牢。就连战斗也是对本来可以做成什么样的一种糟糕借口。大多数任务在途中就直接坏掉，无法完成。

又一个失败的抢先体验作品，而那些把两种大麻香烟放进游戏里的兼职业余开发者，甚至都不懂如何与社区建设性地合作进行模组制作和内容创作。

Bonkers great game!
I'm still playing it and will be updating this review as I go.
Edit: At this point the inventory management is breaking my game experience. With every action, it either closes all the windows, which resets its position, or opens you're inventory. The inventory is hard-coded positioned so that it covers the whole screen covering the interaction and view on the world around you. It's extremely frustrating and there doesn't seem to be any mod fixing this. No it's not physically broken as in bugged or anything, but it is a broken implementation of inventory management. At start you can cope with it... I hope I can bear this torture because the game itself is really great.

One of the few games that compensate for lack of fancy graphics or 3D world with sheer gameplay. You salvage, you mine, you build, you earn and survive, all aboard veritable coffins that are proudly called 'spacecrafts'. Sadly this is marred by a legion of game-breaking issues.

Pros:
- Developers nailed the art style and made a game that matches it
- Variety of mechanics, lots of different things to do
- Space with 'physics' done in a fun way, you use Newtonian physics to travel instead of fighting it
- Sensor gameplay and space combat

Pain Points:
- AI is broken. NPCs sleeping on the floor, drinking water till they are nauseous, stealing your food, denying you docking to one of your ship are just toppings. NPCs walking into fires for food, going into N2-only atmosphere without a helmet, ramming planets, picking fights with police and exterminating police population... NPCs don't live very long, but that's still not the worst of it. What takes the cake: ramming player, venting player's atmosphere, flinging player into the planet, accelerating player to 2km/s in seconds (when you have 1km/s delta-v)... that's the game's norm for the NPCs.
- Game has depth but player has little to affect that depth. As an example oxygen and atmosphere overall are detailed yet there is no airlock (only a mislabeled docking port) so you choice is to cheat by fusing yourself with the docking port or to let atmosphere out. No proper atmosphere distribution either (the bigger the ship the more apparent it becomes). Medical conditions are detailed, yet there is very little feedback for yourself and no option at all to treat NPCs. Fuel and power can't be transferred between ships, sans dragging massive tanks around. Sensors aren't configurable.
- BUGS. Dialogues get stack; 'Resume action' button sometimes doesn't work (lacks error feedback?); Autopause doesn't work half the time; NPCs can't wake up; Jump cables take longer to install than proper cables.

Cons:
- Inventory. The bigger your ship the more frustating it becomes (like having multiple bins full of bags, cargo pants in those bags, just to store small items like spare parts and food).
- You have to baby-sit a lot of actions (malfucntioning autopause doesn't help).
- Orders have no proper queue or priorities.
- Lack of variety in a lot of aspects, especially for ships (Ex: a single RCS, single power source). Quite a few derelicts are practically new because there is no 'obsolete' parts or technologies. Damage could have had more depth too. 
- Progression needs refining
- Overall incomplete.

I want to love this game, but at this point the game is not worth it. The game is only half done.

这是少数几款用纯粹的游戏玩法弥补了缺乏华丽画面或3D世界的游戏之一。你打捞、你采矿、你建造、你赚钱并生存，这一切都在名副其实的棺材上，它们被自豪地称为“宇宙飞船”。遗憾的是，这被一大堆破坏游戏的问题所玷污。

优点：
- 开发者敲定了美术风格，并做出了一款与之匹配的游戏
- 机制多样，有很多不同的事情可做
- 太空“物理”以有趣的方式呈现，你利用牛顿物理学来移动，而不是与之对抗
- 传感器玩法和太空战斗

痛点：
- AI坏了。NPC睡在地板上、喝水喝到恶心、偷你的食物、拒绝让你停靠到你自己的一艘船上，这些还只是小菜。NPC为了食物走进火里、不戴头盔进入只有氮气的大气、撞行星、挑衅警察并灭绝警察人口……NPC活不了多久，但这还不是最糟的。最离谱的是：撞玩家、排放玩家的大气、把玩家甩进行星、在几秒内把玩家加速到2公里/秒（当你只有1公里/秒的Δv时）……这就是游戏中NPC的常态。
- 游戏有深度，但玩家几乎无法影响这种深度。例如，氧气和整体大气做得很细致，却没有气闸（只有一个标错的对接端口），所以你的选择要么是把自己和对接端口融合在一起作弊，要么就是把大气放出去。也没有合适的大气分配（船越大就越明显）。医疗状况做得很细致，但你几乎得不到关于自身的反馈，也完全没有治疗NPC的选项。燃料和电力无法在飞船之间转移，除非拖着巨大的储罐到处跑。传感器不可配置。
- BUG。对话会堆叠；“恢复动作”按钮有时不起作用（缺少错误反馈？）；自动暂停一半时间都不工作；NPC无法醒来；跨接电缆安装起来比正规电缆还久。

缺点：
- 物品栏。你的船越大就越令人沮丧（就像有多个装满袋子的箱子，袋子里还有工装裤，只是为了存放备件和食物之类的小物品）。
- 很多操作你都得亲自盯着（自动暂停失灵更是雪上加霜）。
- 命令没有合适的队列或优先级。
- 很多方面缺乏多样性，尤其是飞船（例如：只有一个RCS、一个电源）。相当多的废弃船实际上几乎是新的，因为没有“过时”的部件或技术。损伤本也可以更有深度。
- 进度需要改进
- 总体不完整。

我想爱上这款游戏，但就目前而言，这游戏不值得。这游戏只完成了一半。

Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

Ce jeu ressemble plus à un GTA 2 horreur SF, dans l'espace qu'à un jeu de construction de vaisseaux. De plus, l'histoire et l'univers dans lequel on évolue est génial et prenant.

Les points faibles du jeu, qui j'espère seront améliorés : 
- la gestion de l'inventaire est compliqué et fait perdre beaucoup de temps,
- les objets au sol peuvent bugger si il y en a trop et disparaître après la relance de la sauvegarde.
- L'Editeur de vaisseaux qu'on nous propose est un enfer, presque inutilisable.
- Pour finir, le jeu n'est pas traduit ce qui un point pour le coup vraiment négatif car il y a beaucoup à lire.
 
Malgré tous ses points négatifs, je pense que ce jeu pourrait être vraiment incroyable; quand il sera fini.

这款游戏更像是一款太空背景的科幻恐怖版GTA 2，而不是一款飞船建造游戏。此外，剧情和我们所处的宇宙非常精彩且引人入胜。

游戏的缺点，希望这些能得到改进：
- 物品栏管理很复杂，浪费大量时间，
- 地上的物品如果太多可能会出bug，并在重新加载存档后消失。
- 提供给我们的飞船编辑器简直是地狱，几乎无法使用。
- 最后，游戏没有翻译，这一点确实是非常负面的，因为有很多内容要读。
 
尽管有所有这些负面之处，我认为这款游戏可能会非常惊艳；等它完成的时候。

[H1]The perfect game if you like outer space, hard Sci-Fi and are a masochist.[/h1]

[b]You will suffer[/b] the well crafted setting and lore, as this is a highly immersive game, and the art and music will make you feel you are that nobody trying to keep a rusty bucket of a ship flying to scrape a meal in the void that is your character.

[b]You will suffer[/b] of chronic diseases from being raised in low-g, so you have no muscle mass and poor sight.

[b]You will suffer[/b] the complexity and pain of human relations, as you'll have lasting relations with a bunch of NPCs, that can be your friends, enemies, lovers, employees or employers or, even worse, ex-lovers.

[b]You will suffer[/b] from a highly detailed ship building and fixing system, where everything that exists can break, and will. Oxygen will leak out if the hull is breached, fuel will run out, cables will short.

[b]You will suffer[/b] hunger, thirst, suffocation, sickness and addiction, as this game has realistic survival mechanics, and the economy mechanics will only make it worse, as you'll need to pay for everything... or pray the cops don't see you taking it.

[b]You will suffer[/b] from the scars of the past, as the well though out character creation system has you starting at 18, and then consuming time learning skills or having youthful adventures until you choose to go independent and in debt. [spoiler] (It also allows you to choose to be a he, she or they, but that I didn't suffer).[/spoiler]

[b]You will suffer[/b] from a complex and claustrophobic inventory system, that has two batteries taking the same bulk space as a machete. Think it's cool that you can "Russian doll" items into backpacks, tool boxes, crates and bins? Try finding anything after you stopped playing for a weekend.

[b]You will suffer[/b] in frustration as you ponder [i]"What does 'Newtonian' even mean?"[/i] as you realize that no, there's not enough time to break from the 780 m/s acceleration your ship has before it crashes into the derelict you wanted to scavenge.

[b]You will suffer[/b] from the random bug and poor optimization, as this game still is in early access, but your suffering will be even worse when you learn key features, like ship to ship combat, won't be available until later in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1022980/view/3120428406777089414]the road map.[/url]

 ...so, as I said, get this game if you are a masochist and like outer space and hard sci-fi.

[H1]如果你喜欢外太空、硬科幻，而且是个受虐狂，那这就是完美的游戏。[/h1]

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为这是一个极具沉浸感的游戏，精心打造的世界观和背景设定会让你感同身受，美术和音乐会让你觉得自己就是那个无名小卒，驾驶着一艘锈迹斑斑的破船，在虚空中挣扎着挣口饭吃——这就是你的角色。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为你在低重力环境中长大，患有慢性疾病，所以你没有肌肉，视力也很差。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为人际关系的复杂与痛苦，你会和一群NPC建立持久的关系，他们可能是你的朋友、敌人、恋人、雇员或雇主，甚至更糟——前任。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为极其细致的飞船建造和维修系统，所有存在的东西都可能坏掉，而且一定会坏。船体破裂氧气就会泄漏，燃料会耗尽，电缆会短路。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为饥饿、口渴、窒息、疾病和成瘾，这款游戏有逼真的生存机制，而经济机制只会让情况更糟，因为你什么都要付钱……或者祈祷警察没看见你顺手牵羊。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为过去的伤疤，精心设计的角色创建系统让你从18岁开始，然后花时间学习技能或享受青春冒险，直到你选择独立并背上债务。[spoiler]（它还允许你选择他、她或他们，但这一点我没受折磨）。[/spoiler]

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为复杂而幽闭的库存系统，两节电池占的空间和一把砍刀一样大。觉得能把物品像俄罗斯套娃一样塞进背包、工具箱、板条箱和垃圾桶里很酷？试试停玩一个周末后再找任何东西。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为当你琢磨[i]“牛顿力学到底是什么意思？”[/i]时的那种挫败感，当你意识到不，没有足够的时间从飞船780米/秒的加速度中减速，它就要撞上你想去拾荒的废弃飞船了。

[b]你将饱受折磨[/b]，因为随机的bug和糟糕的优化，这款游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，但当你得知关键功能，比如飞船对飞船战斗，要到[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1022980/view/3120428406777089414]路线图[/url]的后期才会推出时，你的折磨会更甚。

……所以，就像我说的，如果你是受虐狂，喜欢外太空和硬科幻，就买这款游戏吧。

items.text:
I have to thank the dev for responding to my review. I initially mistook the fast forwarding controls on map screen for functionality to speed up travel when it just simulates the travel to let you preview where you will end up and got blindsided into thinking there's no way to speed up the travel time.

This game has a lot of what I'm looking for in games. Open ended sandbox to play around in. All the retro future stuff give the game very nice theme.

I really like the social interactions of the game, it's a flexible system to interact with other characters. The whole NPC side of the game is satisfying, at least at the first sight of it, I'm yet to explore it more but the whole interaction system with NPCs gives the game feeling of playing in a living world, something very few games pay attention to. The NPCs and the game world seems to be living its own life independent of you, which is really great for immersion.

I haven't played enough with the ship building/breaking to have opinion formed but my initial thoughts are positive. The game seems to be all about of breaking ships apart and putting them back together and so far, I'm liking the way it accomplishes it.

I don't think I have any criticisms related to the gameplay so far, at least as far as unfinished early access state of the game presents. What the game lacks is pretty much what you would expect from an early access, just polish. Most of which is in UI area, notably using the inventory is a bit clunky since opening it takes most of the screen making it hard to see anything when you want to both see stuff on the ground and see what's around you. Tho, that's not a big issue and something I could live with.

From technical side, the game automatically minimizes when it loses focus on full screen which I would be happy to see fixed but in my situation, playing on windowed mode is no problem.

I've also noticed an issue with sliders in game. Both volume sliders and menu scroll bars. Anytime I click the slider, it starts misbehaving. Although, if I use scrollwheel, the issue doesn't appear to happen, only when I click on the slider with a mouse button. When that happens, the slider starts moving upwards or downwards at random as if I was continously moving it in regular time intervals, locking it at minimum or maximum value. The movement is erratic but alsways drives towards bottom or top. I also noticed that the behavior is similar to what happens when you have a faulty gamepad connected, when it sends thumbpad signals even when it is not touched. That reminded me that I use Lexip Pu94 mouse, which has a built in joystick that is fairly easy to move since it's built into the body of the mouse. I noticed the scrollbars seem to react to the movement of this joystick, although not reliably.

In case it is relevant and helps the dev to fix the issues, I'm playing through proton on linux.
items.text_zh:
我必须感谢开发者回复了我的评测。我最初把地图界面上的快进控制误认为是加速旅行的功能，而它其实只是模拟旅行，让你预览最终会到达哪里，于是我误以为根本没有办法加快旅行时间。

这款游戏有很多我在游戏中寻找的东西。开放式的沙盒供你随意游玩。所有那些复古未来主义的东西给游戏带来了非常棒的主题。

我非常喜欢游戏中的社交互动，这是一个与其他角色互动的灵活系统。游戏里NPC这一整个方面令人满意，至少乍看之下是这样，我还没深入探索，但与NPC的整套互动系统让游戏有一种生活在活生生的世界里的感觉，这是很少有游戏会关注的。NPC和游戏世界似乎独立于你过着自己的生活，这对沉浸感来说真的很棒。

我还没怎么玩飞船建造/拆解，所以还没形成看法，但我的初步想法是正面的。这款游戏似乎就是关于把飞船拆开再拼回去，到目前为止，我喜欢它实现这一点的方式。

我认为到目前为止我对玩法没有任何批评，至少就游戏未完成的抢先体验状态所呈现的内容而言是这样。游戏缺少的东西基本就是你对抢先体验会预期到的东西，只是打磨而已。其中大部分在UI方面，尤其是使用物品栏有点笨拙，因为打开它会占据大部分屏幕，当你想同时看到地上的东西和周围的东西时就很难看清任何东西。不过，这不是什么大问题，是我可以忍受的。

从技术方面来说，游戏在全屏模式下失去焦点时会自动最小化，我很乐意看到这个问题被修复，但在我的情况下，用窗口模式玩没问题。

我还注意到游戏里滑块的一个问题。音量滑块和菜单滚动条都是如此。每当我点击滑块，它就开始出毛病。不过，如果我用滚轮，这个问题似乎就不会出现，只有当我用鼠标按键点击滑块时才会。出现这种情况时，滑块会随机地开始向上或向下移动，就好像我在以固定的时间间隔持续移动它一样，把它锁在最小值或最大值。移动很不稳定，但总是朝着底部或顶部移动。我还注意到这种行为类似于你连接了一个有故障的游戏手柄时会发生的情况，即使没碰它，它也会发送摇杆信号。这让我想起我用的是Lexip Pu94鼠标，它内置了一个摇杆，因为就嵌在鼠标本体里，所以相当容易移动。我注意到滚动条似乎会对这个摇杆的移动做出反应，虽然并不可靠。

如果这有关系并能帮助开发者修复这些问题的话，我是在Linux上通过proton玩的。

items.text:
Entertaining, for early access.
-Fun to learn while dying type game
-Awesome character generation, repeats after a few times
-Fixing/building your ship is fun while it is breaking down
-Cops coming for you to check on your license is funny
-Crew social is very interesting, buggy, but interesting

Really needs a lot more work though - bugs from 1/12/23:
-After visiting a few derelicts and having a lot of stuff on your ship, it will start becoming choppy/low fps
-The orders management is cool, yet fails/crashes a lot
-Inventory UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the huge text, you accidentally click off one of the tiny inventory boxes you move, which is both annoying and sometimes rarely useful
-Social UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the small text
-Trade UI is horrible, have to scroll every time you open a sub-list
-Esc key, escapes everything except right click menu
-The crew will constantly interrupt you, repair a hole in the hull, doesn’t matter
-No good way to get crew to stop interrupting aside from mod, which removes it completely
-Crew will constantly go outside without helmets and die lock doors if you could get all the codes
-Crew dying on another ship, you cannot drag them to your ship, fire them and leave them to die (or extra eva suit)
-Cops will ram you
-Bugs/lacking in many ship systems, airlocks are almost pointless since you cannot automate them and lose air fast. (sure you can manually vacuum the space, but the manual controls are full screen for a tiny panel and a just get annoying after a while)
-Nav station won’t list all door codes, and you have guess which door is which code
-Lots of skills are useless, some do a little, 4 of them do a lot
-Making money/economy is weird - you can get a lot of stuff, but cannot sell it all. If you have a loan, you will be bogged down in bills, store refreshes every 4 shifts, but you have to pay the loan every shift... So you get the ship that doesn't have a loan and then it becomes pointless
-Yeah you can jettison stuff.... one at a time.... 100s of trash.... ugh

Wishes: 
-multiplayer, or at least better crew. 
-Easy way to make ships and add them to the game without modding. 
-Simple switch automation (at least a proximity switch)
-By the time you find the Cart, you really don’t need the cart
-Simple crafting - cart, change 02 sensor to N2, cart, blue light to red light, cart

Tldr: After 100+ hours played, the bugs will beat you into not wanting to play this awesome game. Worth $20, yea
items.text_zh:
在抢先体验阶段，这游戏挺有意思的。
- 边死边学的那种游戏，很好玩
- 角色生成很棒，但重复几次后就腻了
- 飞船一边坏一边修/造还挺有趣的
- 警察来查你的执照很好笑
- 船员社交非常有意思，有bug，但有意思

不过真的还需要大量打磨——截至23年1月12日的bug：
- 访问了几艘废弃飞船、船上东西多了之后，游戏会开始卡顿/掉帧
- 命令管理系统很酷，但经常失效/崩溃
- 物品栏UI很糟糕，没法调整巨大文本的大小，你移动那些小物品栏格子时一不小心就会点到外面，既烦人又偶尔有点用
- 社交UI很糟糕，没法调整小文本的大小
- 交易UI很糟糕，每次打开子列表都得滚动
- Esc键，什么都能退出，就是退不出右键菜单
- 船员会不停地打断你，哪怕是在修补船体上的破洞，也一样
- 除了用mod（而且mod会把它完全移除）之外，没有好办法让船员停止打断你
- 船员会不停地不戴头盔就跑到外面去然后死掉，如果能拿到所有密码的话倒是可以把门锁上
- 船员在另一艘船上死了，你没法把他们拖到你的船上，只能解雇他们、任他们去死（或者多备一套EVA服）
- 警察会撞你
- 许多飞船系统有bug/不完善，气闸几乎毫无意义，因为你没法自动化它们，而且漏气很快。（当然你可以手动给空间抽真空，但手动控制是一个小面板却占满全屏，过一会儿就让人烦）
- 导航站不会列出所有门的密码，你得猜哪个门对应哪个密码
- 很多技能没用，有些有点用，有4个技能作用很大
- 赚钱/经济系统很奇怪——你能搞到很多东西，但没法全卖掉。如果你有贷款，你会被账单压得喘不过气，商店每4个班次刷新一次，但你每个班次都得还贷款……所以你就只能选那艘没有贷款的船，然后贷款系统就变得毫无意义
- 是啊，你可以把东西扔出去……一次一个……几百件垃圾……唉

愿望：
- 多人模式，或者至少把船员做好点。
- 有简单的方法造船并把它们加进游戏，不用做mod。
- 简单的开关自动化（至少来个接近开关）
- 等你找到购物车的时候，你其实已经不需要购物车了
- 简单的合成——购物车，把O2传感器换成N2，购物车，把蓝灯换成红灯，购物车

长话短说：玩了100多个小时之后，这些bug会把你折磨到不想再玩这款超棒的游戏。值20美元，是的

I want to start out by saying I like the idea of this game and I think it will be a great game some day. While certain parts of the game are well explained (navigation, life support), large portions of the game will require you to post threads on reddit begging for answers. Why am I locked out of the delivery location of this mission? How does the dialogue minigame work? How am I supposed to afford the 8 kg of helium my reactor chews through every single ♥♥♥♥♥♥ minute? WHY ON EARTH CAN'T I ROTATE ITEMS IN MY INVENTORY?!

There is some amazing world building going on here, and I strongly urge people to support it. The harsh, unforgiving gameplay would be an absolute blast if things were a bit more clear, but as it is, it's like a very challenging quest where you get to the end and realize you went the wrong way.

I have a sneaking suspicion that somebody is going to respond to this and reveal to me that most of my confusion is self-inflicted somehow.

我想先说，我喜欢这款游戏的理念，我认为它有一天会成为一款很棒的游戏。虽然游戏的某些部分解释得很好（导航、生命维持），但游戏的大部分内容都需要你在reddit上发帖求答案。为什么我被锁在这个任务的交付地点之外？对话小游戏是怎么运作的？我到底该怎么负担得起我的反应堆每♥♥♥♥♥♥分钟就消耗掉的8公斤氦气？我到底为什么不能在物品栏里旋转物品？！

这里有一些惊人的世界构建，我强烈建议大家支持它。如果事情能更清楚一些，这种严酷、无情的玩法绝对会非常过瘾，但就目前而言，这就像是一个极具挑战性的任务，你走到最后才发现自己走错了路。

我隐隐怀疑会有人回复这个，并向我揭示我的大部分困惑其实都是我自己造成的。

TL;DR: Refund / Ne pas acheter.

Au début, j'ai vu un jeu de simulation où on peut se balader dans son vaisseau, changer de vaisseau, gérer son inventaire, des traits qui rendent les persos différents... Ça avait l'air intéressant.


--- Récolte de données ---

Au lancement, le jeu demande un accès à Internet alors que c'est un jeu hors ligne. Déjà, ça sent la bonne télémétrie sans rien demander, ça part mal.


--- Langues ---

On peut changer le format des dates et l'unité de température dans les options, mais ça se limite à ça (d'ailleurs, pas de Fahrenheit, désolé les Ricains et les Canadiens).

Pas de choix de langue ni rien, le jeu est sortit y a 2 ans, mais faut croire que les devs n'ont pas voulu prendre 1 journée pour traduire le jeu dans 2/3 langues.

C'est un détail certes, mais dans un jeu ou 90 % du gameplay requiert de lire du texte, c'est dommage.


--- Création de personnage ---


Dès la création de perso ça commence déjà à sentir le pâté ; la création de perso est excessivement limitée.

C'est possible de choisir sa couleur de peau et son "pronom" pour être "non-binary", par contre impossible de choisir la couleur de ses cheveux ou de sa pilosité.

Ne vous y trompez pas, cette fausse inclusivité n'est là que pour cacher la misère, pour que les 2-3 plus manipulables se sentent moins frustrés d'avoir seulement peu de choix dans ce qui leur est proposé.

D'ailleurs, changer sa couleur de peau randomize le personnage, donc le faites pas en dernier, vous allez perdre les 4 pauvres options que vous avez choisies.


--- UI ---

Passons au plus gros point noir de ce jeu : l'UI.

L'UI est lamentable, à tel point que je crois pas avoir déja croisé un blasphème pareil dans mon expérience de joueur.

Les cases de l'inventaire sont minuscules et les menus sont tellement laids qu'ils pourraient être exposés dans des musées d'art contemporain.

Ces derniers ne sont au mieux pas ergonomiques, aux pires incompréhensibles.


--- Graphismes ---

Pour le 2d point noir de ce jeu, les graphismes. Étant habitué a dwarf fortress, aurora4x et moult autres jeux indés aux graphismes sommaires, je râle très rarement sur ce point en général.

Mais là, ce n'est pas possible, il faut en parler.

On ne comprend rien à ce qu'on a à l'écran, j'ai parfois presque l'impression que c'est des textures aléatoires. Je pense que les textures ont été faites en prenant une couleur unie et en ajoutant du bruit dessus.

--- Conclusion ---

Refund + passez votre chemin. 

On verra ce que ça donnera d'ici quelques années s'il n'est pas abandonné d'ici là.

TL;DR：退款 / Ne pas acheter。

一开始，我看到一个模拟游戏，你可以在自己的飞船里四处走动、更换飞船、管理自己的库存、还有让角色变得不同的特质……看起来挺有意思。


--- 数据收集 ---

启动时，这游戏明明是个离线游戏却要求联网。一开始就感觉是在未经请求的情况下搞那种典型的遥测，开局就不妙。


--- 语言 ---

可以在选项里更改日期格式和温度单位，但也就仅此而已（顺带一提，没有华氏度，抱歉了美国人和加拿大人）。

没有语言选择之类的，这游戏都出了2年了，但看来开发者连花1天时间把游戏翻译成2/3种语言都不愿意。

这确实是个细节，但在一个90%的玩法都需要阅读文本的游戏里，这很可惜。


--- 角色创建 ---


从角色创建开始就已经开始发臭了；角色创建极其有限。

可以选择肤色和“代词”来成为“非二元性别”，但无法选择头发或体毛的颜色。

别误会，这种虚假的包容只是为了掩盖糟糕的现状，让那2-3个更容易被操纵的人对自己在所提供的选项中只有很少选择这件事少一些挫败感。

另外，更改肤色会随机化角色，所以别最后才做，你会失去你选的那4个可怜选项。


--- UI ---

接下来谈谈这游戏最大的黑点：UI。

UI糟糕透顶，以至于我觉得在我的玩家经历中从没见过如此亵渎的东西。

库存格子小得可怜，菜单丑得简直可以拿去当代艺术博物馆展出。

这些菜单往好了说是不符合人体工学，往坏了说是让人无法理解。


--- 画面 ---

这游戏第二大黑点，画面。由于习惯了dwarf fortress、aurora4x以及许多其他画面简陋的独立游戏，我一般很少在这点上抱怨。

但这里，这不行，必须得说说。

屏幕上是什么根本看不懂，我有时几乎觉得那是随机纹理。我觉得这些纹理就是拿一种纯色然后往上面加噪点做出来的。

--- 结论 ---

退款 + 别碰。

看看几年后它会变成什么样吧，如果到那时它还没被放弃的话。

Yeah, it's not ready.

Imagine a hybrid of a Dwarf Fortress-likes and The Sims like, but the social interactions of the sims-like portion are so convoluted that the AI doesn't know how to manage itself, while the dwarf-fortress like is missing sorely needed features like a global inventory to allow the player to find that soldering iron with a charged battery somewhere in the ship. To be honest I kept raising the alarm that the game was missing required genre features for years of EA while the dev was engaging in whatever avant garde development bulls***ery they were doing. Hell, the Ai doesn't know how to find a fresh battery for it's equipment, or even how to take it's suit off to use hygiene wipes, while the player is stuck manually going through every storage bin and toolbox looking for items to equip NPCs.

Roughly 1/4th of the game's core was passable (the core of restoring/salvaging ship parts) and kept the game playable while the other 75% was half baked, poorly realized jank that could best be explained as a placeholder while the game is fleshed out.

The problem is that the game got pushed out of early access with only a quick bug fixing pass over a game whose features are mostly jank that either poorly interacts with the core game, or outright gets in the way of what little fun there is to have.
items.text_zh:
是的，它还没准备好。

想象一下《矮人要塞》类游戏和《模拟人生》类游戏的混合体，但《模拟人生》那部分的社交互动如此错综复杂，以至于AI都不知道如何管理自己，而《矮人要塞》那部分则严重缺失急需的功能，比如全局库存，让玩家能在飞船某处找到那把带充电电池的烙铁。说实话，在抢先体验的这些年里，我一直在大声疾呼游戏缺少必要的类型功能，而开发者却在搞他们那些前卫的开发胡扯。见鬼，AI连怎么给它的设备找到一块新电池都不知道，甚至不知道怎么脱下它的宇航服来使用卫生湿巾，而玩家则被困在手动翻遍每一个储物箱和工具箱，寻找装备NPC的物品。

游戏核心大约四分之一的部分还过得去（修复/打捞飞船部件的核心），让游戏保持可玩，而另外75%则是半生不熟、实现糟糕的破烂，最好解释为游戏在充实完善期间的占位内容。

问题在于，游戏被推出了抢先体验阶段，只对游戏做了一遍快速的bug修复，而游戏的功能大多是破烂，要么与核心游戏互动不良，要么干脆妨碍了那仅有的一点乐趣。
